verdicts.reason: A has a good top-to-bottom flow and fills the canvas, but the bottle has come loose from its cream circle, leaving an empty disc on the left with a small bottle floating beside it. The pill buttons have turned into hard-edged rectangles, and the centred NEW and Try It buttons don't line up with the left-aligned headline. B keeps the bottle-in-circle badge and the pill buttons intact, but the bottle cap is jammed against the top edge, the buttons sit right-aligned against the left-aligned headline, and the bottom ~40% of the canvas is empty, so the whole layout looks top-heavy.
